text.表参道の高台に位置するヴィンテージマンション、ペアシティのリフォーム。漆喰の壁や: A renovation at Pair City, a vintage block on the high ground of Omotesando. The comfort of being surrounded by natural materials — lime plaster on the walls and ceilings — together with the light and air coming through the wooden shutters, make it as easy as a resort hotel, and let you forget that this is the ground floor of a city apartment block. Solid rosewood flooring laid in herringbone, and wooden shutters fitted to every window, give the rooms a classical air. The striking stone wall facing the entrance draws a visitor inside.
text.コンクリートに直接施工するのではなく、木製床を組んだ上に、15ミリの厚さのローズ: Rather than fixing straight to the concrete slab, we built a timber floor and laid 15 mm solid rosewood over it in herringbone. Finished in natural oil; with time the oils in the timber itself deepen the colour and the sheen.
text.全窓に設置したウッドシャッターは、光の入り方を調整するだけでなく、カーテンやブラ: The wooden shutters fitted to every window not only control how the light enters; unlike curtains or blinds they do not flap in a breeze, so the air from outside can be let in freely. They also conceal the window frames, which belong to the building's common parts, and that in itself lifts the room.
